summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found (investigation only, no changes made) I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → API → `modules/watchlist` → DB. The watchlist-specific wiring is actually correct: - Client always calls the server with `credentials: "include"` (cookie sent every time) — no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist UI. - `modules/watchlist` requires a valid session on every route, derives the user id **server-side** from the session token (never trusts a client-supplied id), and every DB read/write is filtered
